_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so an Education extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. budget_shortfall) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. FUNDING_CRISIS) (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). CRITICAL: in Education, activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases (e.g. 'Standardized test score decline'), which equal NEITHER the condition-codes NOR the diagnosis ids. So NOTHING self-matches and this bridge table is strictly load-bearing before extinction can run - exactly the gap energy-telemetry-adapter.js flags in its _unbound note ('condition-code vocabulary != activation.diagnosticTriggers free-text; needs an alias table before extinction can match'). Education is ENERGY-like here, NOT Finance-like (Finance activation.diagnosticTriggers were diagnosis ids that self-matched).
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(education-pulse-engine.js addFamily loop, L124-146)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS.requiredFamilies OR-gate, L156-162)--> diagnosis id --(education.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(each nodeId is an activation)--> that activation's free-text diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data: issue id === diagnosis id === activation-circuit source). The conditionCodes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is linked to a condition-code when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual OR-gate code, L156-162). evidenceKind on each linkedDiagnoses entry records WHY: 'primaryIndicator'/'secondaryConfirmation' = the condition is a NAMED indicator token of that contract; 'familyOnly' = the condition is linked SOLELY because a shared required family (almost always policy_event) satisfies the OR-gate, not because it is a named indicator. This preserves Finance's bias-against-over-marking while still faithfully modelling the real (loose) gate.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from education.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceAndEnergy: DIFFERENT structure on five axes. (1) FREE-TEXT TRIGGERS (Energy-like, not Finance-like): activation.diagnosticTriggers are free-text phrases, not diagnosis ids, so diagnosis ids do NOT self-match and the whole table is load-bearing. (2) NO dedicated classify(): education-pulse-engine.js maps condition tokens to families INLINE in the addFamily loop (L124-146); the condition tokens ARE the contract primaryIndicator tokens (Finance-like in that one respect). (3) VERY LOOSE OR-GATE - the central Education finding: policy_event is a requiredFamily of FOUR of five contracts (FUNDING_CRISIS, TEACHER_SHORTAGE, ACHIEVEMENT_GAP, ACCREDITATION_FAILURE), and most condition-codes emit policy_event, so a single policy-family condition folds into 4 diagnoses and expands to 28 free-text triggers. The fold is far broader than Finance; see the familyOnly evidenceKind tags. (4) DEAD-END FAMILIES: macro_shock->macro_event dead-ends (same as Finance) AND education_high_stress/structural_stress->structural_event ALSO dead-end (a NAMED structural-stress family that no contract requires; contrast Finance _stress_* which emitted no family at all). (5) ORPHANS: Education 1 activation with triggers-but-no-source (FG) vs Finance 3; plus 3 empty-trigger exempt activations (rPFC, sgACC, SMN).
_provenance.looseGateNote: Because policy_event is a requiredFamily of 4/5 contracts and OR-semantics govern the gate, budget_shortfall/resource_scarcity/infrastructure_degradation/workforce_gap/outcome_disparity/etc each provide VALIDATING evidence for FUNDING_CRISIS + TEACHER_SHORTAGE + ACHIEVEMENT_GAP + ACCREDITATION_FAILURE simultaneously. This is faithful to the running code, not an authoring choice of this table; it is flagged because it makes the extinction-protection set for any policy condition very large (28 of the domain's free-text triggers).
_provenance.achievementGapCatchAllNote: ACHIEVEMENT_GAP is the ONLY contract with catchAllBlocked:false (education-pulse-engine.js L60), i.e. it can be stress-activated without matching evidence. Its alias entries still ground normally; the catch-all property is noted for the extinction/validation consumer.

This is the stress catch-all token; the one catch-all-eligible diagnosis (ACHIEVEMENT_GAP, catchAllBlocked:false) is reached by external activation-without-evidence, NOT by this condition-code.

activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc.reason: Activation has diagnosticTriggers but its brainNodeId appears in NO issue._authored circuit, and no condition-code chain reaches it (there is no arts/creativity evidence family or contract). It DOES appear in the connectivity edge graph (IPS->FG, FG->BROCA) but that graph is not the diagnostic/extinction chain. Under current wiring nothing marks FG active, so extinction (energy-extinction.js) would ALWAYS list it for retirement. No grounded alias exists; NOT fabricated. Needs authoring into an issue circuit (e.g. an arts-education failure) before extinction should touch it. Education analog of the Finance orphans; Education has ONE.
